headline: Margin recovery expected in 2HFY27E

Despite GST-related headwinds (2.4% of sales) and provision on SAR (0.8% of sales), LEMONTRE IN’s operational performance was ahead our estimates with EBITDA margin of 44.2% (PLe 42.8%).

As renovation intensity tapers (1.9%/1.3% in FY27E/FY28E respectively) and pricing actions mitigate GST impact, we expect EBITDA margins to improve to 48.6%/49.7%/51.0% in FY27E/FY28E/FY29E, respectively.
